run_metadata.coverage_summary: DEGRADED RUN (network egress restricted — same condition as the 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-09 runs). All outbound WebFetch/HTTP egress was blocked by the environment's egress proxy: every external host returned EGRESS_BLOCKED, including example.com, www.tenders.gov.au and www.tenders.nsw.gov.au, confirming a blanket organisation egress denial rather than any single-site outage. Consequently NO tender detail page or specification document could be opened this run, so no deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, values or contacts could be extracted or verified. The only working external tool was WebSearch (an index returning titles, URLs and short snippets). Discovery was therefore limited to headline-level opportunities corroborated from search snippets that reference a buyer-originated source, prioritising those published or closing recently. Tier 1 (AusTender + all state/territory portals) was probed via WebSearch; Tier 2 (councils via VendorPanel, GBEs/water corporations, universities) sampled; Tier 3 mandatory check performed (SAP Ariba Discovery, Woolworths Partner Hub, RangeMe/Coles, EstimateOne) — no publicly-visible corporate RFx confirmable, portals recorded in discovered_sources only. Every tender is flagged headline-level and pending detail; every date/value shown is from a search snippet and flagged for re-verification. Stale/closed items were actively identified and EXCLUDED (Melbourne Water Cardinia Dam Upgrade RFP closed 27-Mar-2026; University of Wollongong ServiceNow EOIs closed 04-Sep-2026). Nothing was fabricated.
gaps: NETWORK EGRESS BLOCK (primary cause of degraded run): every WebFetch call and every attempt to reach an external host was denied by the environment egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED), confirmed against example.com as well as tender portals. This is an organisation egress policy; not retried or routed around per proxy guidance.

No tender detail pages or specification documents could be opened, so deliverables/requirements/evaluation-criteria/value/contact extraction was impossible for ALL entries; every tender is headline-level and pending detail.
Tier 1 AusTender and all eight state/territory portals were reachable via WebSearch snippets only; full ATM/RFT lists and pagination could not be swept.

Tier 3 SAP Ariba Discovery: no specific currently-open Australian public RFP could be confirmed via WebSearch this run; individual postings are registration-gated and require an authenticated session (deferred). Woolworths Partner Hub and RangeMe/Coles are supplier-registration onboarding portals (no discrete open RFx publicly visible); EstimateOne subcontractor packages are login-gated. Recorded as portals only; no corporate tenders fabricated.

NT Department of Logistics & Infrastructure QTOL tender (tendersonline.nt.gov.au/Tender/DetailsFTO/3277) showed a close date of 06-Oct-2026 2:00 PM ACST in a snippet but NO title or buying-agency detail was captured; excluded rather than recorded with a guessed title.

AusTender PR10031930 - RASS (Remote Air Services Subsidy, Dept of Infrastructure) appeared as a current ATM but with commencement 1-Sep/1-Oct-2026 implying lodgement may have closed; status could not be verified without the detail page, so it was not listed as an open tender.

Townsville City Council waste-management/landfill RFT (VendorPanel) surfaced in one snippet with close 28-Oct-2026 10:00 AM Brisbane but could NOT be re-corroborated (tender number not captured) on a second search — included at headline level with an explicit low-confidence flag pending verification.

Closing dates and tender IDs for several buyer-originated opportunities (Sydney Water EPCM EOI, University of Sydney PROC-2026-293, Cootamundra-Gundagai RFT 2026/10, Bundaberg TEN/2893) were only partially captured from snippets; left null where not stated.
